title: Pharmacological Characterization of Crotamine Effects on Mice Hind Limb Paralysis
author: Sunamita Lima
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.p7ydrpw

steps.title: Divide Animals into Groups
steps.instruction: Divide the animals into two groups: a control group and a treated group.

substeps.instruction: Administer normal saline (10 ml/kg, i.p.) to the control group.

steps.title: Induce and Measure Writhing
steps.instruction: Induce writhing in the treated group using crotamine and quantify the response.

substeps.instruction: Wait 30 minutes after the first step.
Wait 5 minutes post-injection to allow injection-related writhing to terminate.
Count the number of abdominal constrictions (writhes) for 30 minutes.
